definitions.explanation: Describes something impressive in scale, bearing, or dignity that commands respect or admiration. A prenominal adjective that always appears directly before a noun.

examples.japanese: {堂々|どうどう}たる⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{話|はな}す→話す：00467_hanasu⟧。
examples.english: To speak with a dignified manner.

examples.japanese: {堂々|どうどう}たる⟦{体格|たいかく}→体格：16207_taikaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{男性|だんせい}→男性：01655_dansei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{現|あらわ}れた→現れる：01870_arawareru⟧。
examples.english: A man with an imposing physique appeared.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{城|しろ}→城：03255_shiro⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{何百年|なんびゃくねん}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{歴史|れきし}→歴史：02267_rekishi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧{堂々|どうどう}たる⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧だ。
examples.english: That castle is a magnificent building with hundreds of years of history.

notes:
A prenominal adjective ({連体詞|れんたいし}) that modifies nouns directly. Describes something impressive in scale, bearing, or dignity. The たる form is a classical attributive ending; this word always appears before a noun.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {堂々|どうどう}たる⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧: dignified attitude
- {堂々|どうどう}たる⟦{体格|たいかく}→体格：16207_taikaku⟧: imposing physique
- {堂々|どうどう}たる⟦{風格|ふうかく}→風格：09177_fuukaku⟧: dignified bearing
- {堂々|どうどう}たる⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧: magnificent building
- {堂々|どうどう}たる⟦{成績|せいせき}→成績：03379_seiseki⟧: impressive results

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{堂々|どうどう}→堂々：05895_doudou⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧: the adverbial form — used with verbs (e.g., ⟦{堂々|どうどう}→堂々：05895_doudou⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{歩|ある}く→歩く：00538_aruku⟧, to walk with dignity)
- ⟦{立派|りっぱ}→立派：01093_rippa⟧: splendid, fine — more general and everyday; can describe both appearance and character
- ⟦{威厳|いげん}→威厳：10680_igen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: dignified — focuses specifically on the quality of commanding respect
